//Oidc: Oidc:Authority = the IDP (same address in every component). Oidc:ClientId must equal ClientIds:Shell in src/IDP/appsettings.json; the BFF proves itself with private_key_jwt: its private key file is Oidc:ClientKey (appsettings.Development.json), and its public key is ClientKeys:<this client ID> in the IDP's settings.
//ShellOrigin: The Shell's own address (https): only its pages may open the notifications connection. Must equal ClientBaseUrls:Shell in src/IDP/appsettings.json and ShellOrigin in every MFE BFF.
//MfeOrigins: The MFEs by key: the Shell frames them (CSP frame-src) and its menu links to them - the menu database (EwpBssShellDb microservices.mfe_key) names the key, never the address. Each must equal that MFE's ClientBaseUrls entry in src/IDP/appsettings.json.
//NotificationsApiBaseUrl: The Notifications API (https); the Shell forwards the person's token there.
//ConnectionStrings: MenuDbConnection and BffStateDbConnection hold passwords, so they are NOT in this file (which goes into the container image): Development reads them from appsettings.Development.json, everywhere else from the environment (ConnectionStrings__MenuDbConnection, ConnectionStrings__BffStateDbConnection) or a secret store. Missing = the Shell refuses to start.
